sites.name: broadcast_shape (anonymous namespace)
sites.rule_0_vs_gt1: refused (runtime_error "shapes not broadcastable", no shapes named), before any CUDA call when called first
sites.fix: Z2: equal -> that extent; one is 1 -> the other; else refuse naming both shapes

sites.name: bcast_strides (anonymous namespace)
sites.rule_0_vs_1: operand extent 1 against output 0: stride 0 (no element read); operand extent 0 against B's wrong output extent 1: the operand's contiguous stride, used to read an empty operand (null storage)
sites.fix: none needed once S1 is right (strides for an output extent 0 are never used); unchanged

sites.name: ew_binary (binary dispatch: add/sub/mul/div/max/min ops 0-5)
sites.rule_0_vs_1: via S1 (wrong): out [4,1] for [4,0] (+) [4,1], then binary_kernel reads the empty operand's null pointer (the reading of the lead's memcheck: binary_kernel reads from 0x0)
sites.fix: S1 + Z2 dispatch guard (host, before the launch): an operand with zero elements and an output with elements is refused

sites.name: compare (gt/ge/lt/le/eq/ne, broadcasting)
sites.rule_0_vs_1: via S1 (wrong): compare_kernel over the wrong output reads the empty operand

sites.name: where_nd (cond, x, y broadcast together)
sites.rule_0_vs_1: via S1 twice (wrong): where_kernel reads an empty operand
sites.rule_0_vs_gt1: via S1: refused; the message would not name the three operand shapes (the inner call's intermediate shape)
sites.fix: a three-shape helper over S1's rule that names all three operand shapes + the dispatch guard

sites.name: broadcast_to (= ew_binary(NDArray::zeros(shape), a, add))
sites.rule_0_vs_1: via S1 (wrong): e.g. broadcast_to(mxk [4,1], [4,0]) gives [4,1] and reads zeros([4,0])'s null storage
sites.rule_0_vs_gt1: refused by S1, but only after NDArray::zeros(shape) allocated and memset the left operand (a CUDA call before the refusal on a non-empty target)
sites.fix: check the shapes with S1's rule before the zeros allocation; output shape = S1(shape, a.shape) as before (no new check that the result equals `shape`: that would change results for shapes without a zero extent, e.g. expand([4,3] -> [3]) gives [4,3] today; residual, listed)

sites.name: reduce_to (gradient of a broadcast operand)
sites.rule_0_vs_1: a source extent 0 against a target extent 1 is not summed (test is > 1); reshape to the target then raises "reshape: element count mismatch" (audit F03)
sites.rule_0_vs_gt1: not applicable (a gradient's extent is the output's, which equals the operand's or is broadcast from 1)
sites.fix: Z3: sum every axis with target 1 and source != 1 (0 included); a sum over an empty axis gives zeros (reduce_impl's sum identity 0.f, no element read)

sites.name: matmul batch shape (forward tc::matmul and ops::matmul_backward share it, ENG4)
sites.rule_0_vs_1: not the max rule. Output batch = A's leading extents. Unequal ranks: B's leading extents must all be 1, so A 0 against B 1 gives 0 (NumPy's answer). Equal ranks: batch shapes must be equal, so A 1 against B 0 is refused (NumPy would give 0) -- the same refusal as A 1 against B 3: matmul's documented narrower contract ("no new broadcasting", ENG4)
sites.rule_0_vs_gt1: refused (BatchShape), before any CUDA call, message names both shapes (ENG4)
sites.fix: none: it never produces an extent NumPy would not; extending it to NumPy's full batch broadcasting is new broadcasting (Does not cover). Its zero-batch dB goes through ENG4-F2's zero fill, and the remaining reduce_to call (ops.cpp:873) is S7

sites.file_line: tensor_cuda/tensor_cuda/functional.py:203 (einsum; also tensor_cuda/__init__.py:1387 forwards to it)
sites.name: einsum's aligned operand shapes
sites.rule_0_vs_1: no rule of its own: each operand is reshaped to the union of indices with 1 for an absent index, then multiplied with `*` (S3 via ops::mul) and summed; a shared index with extents 0 and 1 reaches S1
sites.fix: none in Python; fixed by S1

sites.name: axpy_ (param += alpha * other through ew_binary, then a raw copy of param's byte count)
sites.rule_0_vs_1: via S1 (wrong): param [4, 1] with other [4, 0] reads the empty operand; with S1 fixed the update has shape [4, 0] and the raw copy of param's 16 bytes would read past an empty buffer
sites.rule_0_vs_gt1: via S1: refused, but after ew_scalar's launch on `other`
sites.fix: S1's rule checked first (before ew_scalar) and an update with fewer elements than param refused
sites.note: listed under public_ops (tc._C.axpy_) when this census was first written; promoted to a site row after the edit (LEDGER)

sites.name: masked_fill's broadcast of mask against a (via S5) after NDArray::full(a.shape)
sites.rule_0_vs_gt1: refused by S5, but after the fill's allocation (a CUDA call on a device operand)
sites.note: listed under public_ops when first written; promoted to a site row after the edit (LEDGER)
